The threat of its exploding rear is an effective deterrent to predators, but the slightest jolt or fall can cause its premature end.

<b>Miremites</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are small, crawling bugs with a bulbous green abdomen.<ref>Miremite [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Crawling insect with a sizzling bile sack in its abdomen."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Miremites move back and forth along floors or walls, dealing {{Damage|1}} upon contact.

When killed, they pause in the air and build up towards an explosion, which deals {{Damage|2}}. Nearby [[Swamp Squit]]s caught within the blast radius explode as well.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* Survive in smog...
* Choke on bile...
* Feed... or starve...
* Resist the rot...
}}

== Location ==
Miremites can be found throughout [[Bilewater]].
